title: EFF letter to FTC on X consent order [pdf]
summary: EFF (Electronic Frontier Foundation) and allied digital rights organizations submitted a letter to the FTC opposing X's (formerly Twitter) petition to waive a privacy violation consent order, arguing that waiving the order would undermine consumer privacy protections and set a dangerous precedent for corporate accountability.
problem_solved: Advocates against allowing X to escape accountability for past privacy violations that violated a 2011 consent decree.
why_valuable: This advocacy helps maintain FTC enforcement authority over tech companies and protects consumer privacy rights by preventing corporations from easily escaping consequences of documented violations.
